bundle.shortDescription: Build a searchable company brain from your own documents.
bundle.longDescription: Ingest documents, inspect the indexing workflow before anything is spent, and search or ask questions over the result. Analysis runs locally against your own Qdrant; embeddings use an API key you supply.
